comments_text: Chain B sequence (GllD2): DNITKGAYKLGKATRQAGKAIGKAIGKLF. Activity: display activity against S. gallolyticus DPC 6,501, S. pneumoniae, L. innocua DPC 1,768, E. faecalis E265, and E. faecium, a vancomycin resistant Enterococcus strain EC300 (anti-VRE).
title: Extensive bacteriocin gene shuffling in the Streptococcus bovis/Streptococcus equinus complex reveals gallocin D with activity against vancomycin resistant enterococci.
